Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

Roll Guile to deal fire or lightning damage in a 3-by-3 area. Standard and Strong results also push creatures outward.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
Every creature in one visible 3-by-3 area within 5 squares.
Type
Magic / Attack / Control

Choose fire or lightning and make a Guile area spell attack.

Weak
4 damage of the chosen type.
Standard
4 damage of that type; push each target 1 square away from the area's center.
Strong
6 damage of that type; push each target 2 squares away from the center.

Choose the center target's push direction and the order of pushes.
